name: keytomic
description: The Keytomic plugin for Claude. AI SEO automation in Claude for Google and AI search: SEO audits, Search Console insights, keyword research, content calendar, articles and hero images. Find top, new, improving and declining rankings, low-hanging fruits, underperforming pages, keyword cannibalization, zombie pages and question queries; inspect URLs and submit sitemaps; plan and run your content calendar; write and edit articles; manage your brand profile, authors and settings; and check plan usage and integrations on your Keytomic workspace.
